summary: Design platform charters, cloud service catalogues, FinOps workflows, and policy guardrails. Explore the five-day training course.
lede: Cloud platform governance training helps platform and cloud leaders define ownership and controls for shared services. It is for architects, IT finance professionals and governance leads, who practise drafting platform charters and service catalogues, mapping Kubernetes guardrails, and designing cost-allocation and policy-exception workflows.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who set platform operating rules, own cloud service decisions, or connect cloud delivery with risk and financial accountability. It suits professionals with working exposure to cloud services who need to define responsibilities and governance workflows across engineering and business teams.
modules: FOCUS Cost Allocation and Unit Economics
prerequisites: Working knowledge of cloud services, platform or infrastructure operations, and basic cloud cost concepts is recommended. No coding is required; policy-as-code and Rego are introduced conceptually, while exercises focus on governance workflows and artefacts.
